title: Fast World Planner: Advantage-Aware Action-Chunk Policy for Online Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28616v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is central to online planning for model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL), but its iterative refinement incurs planning latency. Reducing refinement iterations often degrades performance, motivating stronger policy guidance learned from the planner. However, existing methods typically learn from the planner through action-level alignment, which does not directly capture the complete $H$-step planner proposal. Moreover, planner imitation leaves further target improvement to online refinement. To address these limitations, we propose FaSt World PlANner (SWAN), an advantage-aware MPPI-based MBRL framework that explicitly represents and improves the complete $H$-step planner proposal to improve policy guidance for efficient online planning. translated_title: 快速世界规划器：面向在线规划的优势感知动作块策略
translated_abstract: 模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制是基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）在线规划的核心方法，但其迭代细化过程会带来规划延迟。减少细化迭代次数往往会导致性能下降，这促使人们从规划器中学习更强的策略引导。然而，现有方法通常通过动作级别的对齐从规划器中学习，无法直接捕获完整的 H 步规划器提案。此外，规划器模仿将进一步提升目标效果的任务留给了在线细化。为解决这些局限，我们提出了 FaSt World PlANner（SWAN），这是一种优势感知的、基于 MPPI 的 MBRL 框架，它显式地表示并改进完整的 H 步规划器提案，以提供更好的策略引导，从而实现高效的在线规划。在提案表示方面，SWAN 将 k-MPPI（一种多模态 MPPI 扩展）与因子分析混合（MFA）动作块策略相结合，以捕获多模态的提案分布（摘要此处截断）。
tldr: SWAN 提出了一种优势感知的基于 MPPI 的 MBRL 框架，通过 k-MPPI 与 MFA 动作块策略显式表示并改进完整的 H 步规划器提案，从而提供更强的策略引导以降低规划延迟、实现高效在线规划。
en_tdlr: SWAN is an advantage-aware MPPI-based MBRL framework that explicitly represents and improves the complete H-step planner proposal by combining k-MPPI with an MFA action-chunk policy, enabling stronger policy guidance for efficient online planning.
